landing.heroTitle: The boilerplate to ship your next app faster.
landing.heroDescription: {name} gives you the UI layer for a modern product: landing page, auth screens, and a dashboard shell that you can drop into another T3 app and wire to your own backend.
landing.featuresTitle: Everything you need, nothing you don't.

features.authDescription: Login and register views with a consistent shell, responsive layout, and polished form styling.
features.dashboardDescription: A complete table-driven workspace for user management that can be wired to your own data layer.
features.componentsDescription: Header, footer, cards, dialogs, and form primitives arranged as a cohesive product UI.
features.themeDescription: Theme switching, responsive spacing, and a neutral visual system ready for a T3 app.

landing.ctaDescription: Create an account and explore the dashboard in under a minute.

legalPrivacy.title: Privacy Policy
legalPrivacy.section1Text1: {legalEntity} (“we”, “us”) operates {serviceName}. This Privacy Policy explains what personal data we collect, why we collect it, how we use and protect it, and the rights you have over it.
legalPrivacy.section1Text2: By creating an account or using the service, you agree to the practices described in this policy. We keep this page up to date and mark the date at the top whenever it changes.
legalPrivacy.section2Item1: Account data - your name, email address, and profile picture when you register, or when you sign in with a third-party provider (such as GitHub OAuth, which shares your name, email, and avatar with your permission).
legalPrivacy.section2Item2: Authentication and security data - a securely hashed password if you register with email (never stored in plain text), session identifiers, IP addresses, and user-agent information, which keep you signed in and help us detect abuse.
legalPrivacy.section2Item3: Content you create - anything you submit, publish, or upload through the service.
legalPrivacy.section2Item4: Analytics and marketing data - only if you consent via our cookie banner; we don't collect any tracking data without your choice.
legalPrivacy.section3Item1: To provide, operate, and maintain your account and the service.
legalPrivacy.section3Item2: To authenticate you and keep your sessions secure.
legalPrivacy.section3Item3: To communicate with you about your account and service changes.
legalPrivacy.section3Item4: To prevent fraud, abuse, and security incidents.
legalPrivacy.section3Item6: To improve the service through aggregated analytics - only where you have consented.
legalPrivacy.section4Text: We process personal data on the following bases: performing the contract you enter into when you create an account; our legitimate interests in operating and securing the service; your consent (for optional analytics and marketing); and compliance with legal obligations.
legalPrivacy.section5Text: We use a small number of strictly necessary and functional cookies - for example to keep you signed in and to remember your consent choices. Optional analytics and marketing cookies are only used if you allow them through the consent banner, which you can reopen at any time from the “Cookie settings” link in the footer. See our <link>Cookie Policy</link> for details.
legalPrivacy.section6Text: We do not sell your personal data. We share it only with a limited set of service providers who process it on our behalf (for example our database hosting provider), and with the identity provider you choose when signing in with OAuth. These providers are bound by data-processing agreements and may only use your data to provide services to us.
legalPrivacy.section7Text: Your data may be processed in countries other than your own. Where we transfer data outside the EEA or the UK, we rely on appropriate safeguards such as standard contractual clauses, and we take steps to keep that data protected to the same standard described in this policy.
legalPrivacy.section8Text: We keep your data for as long as your account is active and for as long as needed to comply with legal obligations, resolve disputes, and enforce our agreements. Session data expires automatically. You can delete your account - and all of your data - at any time from Settings → Profile → Danger zone.
legalPrivacy.section9Intro: Depending on where you live, you may have the right to access, rectify, export, erase, restrict, or object to the processing of your personal data, and to withdraw consent at any time.
legalPrivacy.section9Item1: Access and rectification - review and edit your profile in Settings.
legalPrivacy.section9Item2: Export (portability) - download your data as JSON from Settings → Profile → Account data.
legalPrivacy.section9Item3: Erasure - delete your account in Settings → Profile → Danger zone, which removes your profile, sessions, and content.
legalPrivacy.section9Item4: Withdraw consent - change your cookie choices anytime via the footer “Cookie settings” link.
legalPrivacy.section9Item5: Complaints - contact us first at ; you also have the right to lodge a complaint with your local data-protection authority (EU/UK) or the California Privacy Protection Agency (US).
legalPrivacy.section10Text: We protect your data with encryption in transit, hashed passwords, and access controls. No method of transmission or storage is 100% secure, and we cannot guarantee absolute security.
legalPrivacy.section11Text: The service is not intended for children under 13 (or under 16 in the EU/UK). If you believe a child has provided us personal data, contact us and we will delete it.
legalPrivacy.section12Text: We may update this policy from time to time. Material changes will be reflected by the “Last updated” date at the top of this page, and continued use of the service after changes means you accept the updated policy.
legalPrivacy.section13Text: Questions about this policy or your data? Contact us at

legalCookies.title: Cookie Policy
legalCookies.section1Text: Cookies are small text files stored on your device by your browser. They let a website recognize your browser and remember information, such as your login state or your preferences.
legalCookies.section2Intro: {serviceName} only sets the cookies listed below. We do not use third-party advertising cookies. Analytics or marketing cookies are only ever set if you explicitly allow them in the consent banner.
legalCookies.section2Note: Note: on HTTPS deployments the auth session cookie is served with a secure prefix (__Secure-better-auth.session_token). If you enable additional authentication plugins (for example last-login-method or OAuth popups), extra functional cookies may be set - update this table accordingly.
legalCookies.section3Text: Essential and functional cookies are required for the service to work and are therefore exempt from consent. For any optional categories, we ask for your consent through the banner that appears on your first visit. You can accept all, accept only essential cookies, or open preferences to choose per category.
legalCookies.section3Item1: Withdraw or change your choice - use the “Cookie settings” link in the footer, or your browser's cookie controls, at any time.
legalCookies.section3Item2: How long consent lasts - your choice is stored in a cookie for one year, after which you'll be asked again. We may also re-ask if our policy changes materially.
legalCookies.section4Text: Most browsers let you view, block, or delete cookies through their settings. Blocking essential cookies may prevent the service from working correctly (for example, keeping you signed in).
legalCookies.section5Text: Questions about this policy? Contact us at
